brands.name: Jekyll & Hyde Musical
brands.subtitle: Logo and font design
brands.description:
In the world-famous novel Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, Dr Jekyll says:

"Though so profound a double-dealer, I was in no sense a hypocrite; both sides of me were in dead earnest; I was no more myself when I laid aside restraint and plunged in shame, than when I laboured, in the eye of day, at the furtherance of knowledge or the relief of sorrow and suffering."

Jekyll & Hyde Irregular, the typeface we designed for the Jekyll & Hyde Musical, adapted from Robert Louis Stevenson's famous work, represents the duality that lies within us all.

"I am everyone. Because everyone has two faces." cümlesini alıntının içinden çıkardım, çünkü Stevenson'ın metninde geçmiyor ve ona aitmiş gibi durması yanlış olur. Bu fikri korumak isterseniz son paragrafa şöyle ekleyebilirsiniz: "...represents the duality that lies within us all, because everyone has two faces."

brands.name: Tim Digitize
brands.subtitle: Logo and corporate identity design
brands.description:
Tim is a digital farming technology brand born from Timsan Tarım, a company with more than 35 years of heritage in agricultural equipment. It develops rate and section control computers and control boxes for spraying, fertilizing and seeding machinery, along with TimApp, the platform farmers use to manage their operations. Every product is designed and manufactured in its own facilities.

The brand's core belief is clear: digital farming should not be the privilege of large farms and big budgets. By offering accessible pricing, cross-brand compatibility and support in the farmer's own language, Tim aims to bring precision farming technology to every field.

brands.name: linn's coffee
brands.subtitle: Logo, packaging and corporate identity design
brands.description: Linn’s Coffee is a specialty coffee brand dedicated to discovering and sharing exceptional coffees from remarkable origins. The brand carefully selects distinctive green coffees, with a particular focus on unique varieties, expressive terroirs, and innovative processing methods. Working closely with experienced coffee professionals throughout the journey, Linn’s seeks to preserve and reveal the individual character of each coffee through thoughtful roasting and meticulous preparation. From vibrant washed coffees to complex natural and anaerobic lots, every Linn’s coffee reflects a spirit of curiosity, precision, and respect for the craft. The brand’s purpose is simple: to bring remarkable coffees to the cup and inspire a deeper appreciation for what coffee can be.

brands.name: Avea - Patlican
brands.subtitle: Logo design
brands.description: Patlıcan was a youth web portal launched by Turkish mobile operator Avea in 2007. Built around the slogan "Avea's youth explosion," the platform brought together everything young people cared about under one roof, from blogs and videos to music, games, social networking, and mobile content. As one of the standout examples from the early days when Turkish operators began connecting with young audiences online, Patlıcan captured the fun, colorful spirit of that era's internet culture.

brands.name: Usta Dönerci
brands.subtitle: Logo design
brands.description: Usta Dönerci is a culinary brand that builds its approach to döner on the principles of craftsmanship, quality, and trust. The brand carefully selects fresh meats, marinates them in its signature spice blend, and prepares them using traditional methods, never compromising on hygiene or flavor standards at any stage. Bread and vegetables sourced daily come together with sauces developed from special recipes to offer guests a consistent and exceptional experience. With customer satisfaction as its foremost priority, Usta Dönerci aims to turn every visit into an enjoyable occasion through its warm and welcoming service, and to carry the authentic taste of traditional döner on to future generations.

brands.name: Vodafone İş Ortağım
brands.subtitle: Logo design
brands.description: Vodafone İş Ortağım was a service program developed by Vodafone Turkey for its corporate customers, designed to meet all of a business's voice and data communication needs from a single source. Featuring competitive corporate tariffs, integrated fixed and mobile internet solutions, device campaigns, and dedicated account advisory services, the program also aimed to add value for businesses through profession-specific packages and an extensive discount network.

brands.name: Row-Z Report
brands.subtitle: Logo design
brands.description: Row-Z Report is an independent sports analytics platform that interprets the game through data, true to its motto "Analysis from the back seats." Based in London and active since 2017, it delivers statistically driven insights across football, basketball and tennis. Using advanced metrics such as its proprietary expected goals (xG) model and expected points (xP), Row-Z Report looks beyond the scoreline to reveal the real story behind team and player performance, making it a trusted resource for fans, professionals and analytics enthusiasts alike.

brands.name: Vodafone Red
brands.subtitle: Logo design
brands.description: Vodafone Red is Vodafone Turkey's premium postpaid tariff family, designed for users with high internet and communication needs. With generous data allowances, zero-rated usage on popular apps, the ability to use domestic allowances abroad, and a wide range of brand partnership benefits, Red offers its users a comprehensive experience that goes beyond a standard mobile plan.

brands.name: KoçZer İşveren Markası
brands.subtitle: Logo design
brands.description: Guided by its "Forward Together" philosophy, Koçzer offers an employer brand that views success as a shared journey. The company strives to create a work environment where every idea is valued and every contribution is recognized, embracing trust, open communication, and mutual respect as the cornerstones of its corporate culture. Investing in the development of its employees, Koçzer encourages them to take on new responsibilities and places achieving goals together at the heart of its approach. Driven by the belief that individual growth is directly linked to organizational growth, Koçzer aims to shape the future hand in hand with its employees.
